title: This US company is repurposing old EV batteries in Nevada to power AI data centres. This could solve one of AI’s biggest problems
description: A new trend is emerging as retired electric vehicle batteries are repurposed to fuel artificial intelligence data centres. Retaining considerable capacity, these batteries offer a budget-friendly energy storage alternative. In Nevada, a pioneering initiative combines solar energy with numerous second-life battery systems, illustrating their effectiveness for intensive computing needs. As these projects grow, they will provide further insights into the durability of these energy solutions for major AI infrastructures.

title: Hohhot, Inner Mongolia: Converting Prairie Winds into Computing Power
description: HOHHOT, CHINA - Media OutReach Newswire - 24 August 2026 - On August 22, 2026, the fourth annual Green Computing Power (Artificial Intelligence) Conference was held on the picturesque Cilechuan Grassland in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia. Centered on the theme 'Building Synergy between Computing and Electricity, Exploring New Horizons in Token Economy, and Creating the Future of Artificial Intelligence Together,' the conference presented the latest research achievements, including the Green Computing Power Development Research Report (2026), and showcased pilot initiatives such as 'millisecond-level urban computing' applications. Prominent companies, including ByteDance and Cambricon, signed a series of significant agreements valued at tens of billions, focusing on green intelligent computing centers and token factories.
